items.title: ThreatBook Peer-Recognized as a Strong Performer in the 2025 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Network Detection and Response — for the Third Consecutive Year
items.description: Recognition we believe underscores global customer trust and proven product excellence for security teams evaluating NDR solutions.
